fields.Tagline: AI pet portraits from your photos

description:
Pettenderly is a browser-based AI portrait studio for people who want a digital keepsake of their cat or dog. Upload one to five photos of the same pet, choose a style such as watercolor or royal portrait, and generate an image to download. The My creations area keeps completed images available for review and download.

The studio also includes two beta tools: You & your pet combines separate person and pet photos, while Photo cleanup lets users describe changes to an existing image. Generated markings and fine details can vary, so users should review results.

Pettenderly is a paid digital service. A starter pack costs $4.99 for 12 credits; each successful image generation uses one credit. Subscription options are also available. It does not offer physical prints or shipping.
